diagram.title: Direct solve or iterative updates?

columns.heading: Normal equation
items: Dense inversion costs $O(p^3)$ in feature count $p$.

columns.heading: Gradient descent
items: Repeat until a stopping criterion is met.
Avoid a dense inverse; tune the learning rate.

diagram.caption: With full column rank, direct solving and converged descent target the same fit. Prefer QR or SVD to explicitly forming an inverse.
